name: logname
porting_notes: Minimal port of OpenBSD logname. Single source file, no complex dependencies. getlogin() shims to amiport_getlogin() which always returns "amiga" since AmigaOS has no multi-user login system. err/errx exit codes changed from 1 to 10 (RETURN_ERROR). atexit cleanup frees argv expansion. 13/13 FS-UAE tests pass.
known_limitations: Always returns "amiga" -- AmigaOS has no multi-user login system. The LOGNAME environment variable is not consulted (matches POSIX spec).
readme:
Short:        Display user's login name
Type:         util/cli
Architecture: m68k-amigaos >= 3.0
Uploader:     duncan (at) bowring (dot) us
Author:       The Regents of the University of California (ported by Duncan Bowring)
Version:      1.10

logname - Display user's login name

Original author: The Regents of the University of California
Ported by Duncan Bowring using amiport (AI-assisted porting toolkit).
Project: https://github.com/bdgscotland/amiport

Cross-compiled with m68k-amigaos-gcc for AmigaOS 3.x (68000+).
Tested in vamos emulator and FS-UAE.

Usage:
  logname

Prints the login name of the current user. On AmigaOS, which is a
single-user operating system with no login system, this always
returns "amiga".

This command accepts no arguments or options. Passing any argument
will cause it to print a usage message and exit with an error.

Includes full source code (original POSIX and ported Amiga versions)
and PORT.md documenting every transformation applied.
